name: Clone Entity Revision
description: Adds a Clone operation to each node revision that deep-duplicates that revision into a brand-new node, recursively cloning referenced paragraphs and making independent copies of file/image fields. Module machine name is clone_entity_revision; the drupal.org project and Composer package are the misspelled drupal/clone_enity_revision (drupal/clone_entity_revision is only a metapackage alias).
